key_insight: Layer-wise generalizations of Barron norms characterize expected discretization error when converting infinite-width layers into finite neural networks.
engineering_relevance: The framework could guide how finite network capacity is allocated across layers to control approximation error.
method: Select optimal infinite-width limits for individual layers.
Discretize all layers into finite networks using a layer-wise Barron-norm characterization.
Analyze local minima through an equidistribution principle analogous to adaptive spline and finite element approximation.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical characterization and optimization-landscape analysis, but no datasets, numerical benchmarks, or empirical results.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish a practical algorithm for computing optimal infinite-width layers or achieving the characterized discretization error.
paper_title: Barron Smoothness for Layers in Deep Neural Networks
